import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 200005;
    static final long INFINITY_VAL = 1000000007L;

    static long X, Y, total;
    static long numerator = -1, denominator = -1;

    static void evaluate(long a, int b) {
        if (a < 0) return;
        if (numerator == -1) {
            numerator = a;
            denominator = b;
            return;
        }
        long diff1 = Math.abs(denominator * X - numerator * Y) * b;
        long diff2 = Math.abs(b * X - a * Y) * denominator;
        if (diff1 > diff2) {
            numerator = a;
            denominator = b;
        } else if (diff1 == diff2 && (b < denominator || (b == denominator && a < numerator))) {
            numerator = a;
            denominator = b;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        X = sc.nextLong();
        Y = sc.nextLong();
        total = sc.nextLong();

        for (int i = 1; i <= total; ++i) {
            long val = i * X / Y;
            evaluate(val - 1, i);
            evaluate(val, i);
            evaluate(val + 1, i);
        }
        System.out.println(numerator + "/" + denominator);
        sc.close();
    }
}
